name: Death Mask: Descent
description: Quantumdeath's descent into Hell. Nether portals now lead to five original circles of Hell - the Ashen Vestibule, the Gorge of Hunger, the Stygian Mire, the Iron City of Dis and the Zenith - each with its own terrain, creatures, boss, structures and sounds, and all of them haunted by VIGIL. "The Past is never dead, it is not even past." - William Faulkner
